title: Italian grammar learner profile
description: The learner's grammar competency state used to select and generate exercises. A complete profile contains one competency record for every variant in the referenced taxonomy, including unpracticed variants. Categories and constructions group variants; CEFR aspects refine a variant but are not independent competencies. Per-variant mastery and confidence are derived from the stored Beta-Binomial state. A prior-only variant has mastery 0.5 and confidence 0; 0.5 is a prior mean, not evidence of learning. Scores are not CEFR levels.
$comment: JSON Schema checks field types and ranges but cannot enforce arithmetic equality between alpha, beta, mastery, and confidence or compare the competency ID set with the external taxonomy. The application must validate those invariants when saving a profile.

schema_version.description: Version of this profile structure and its Beta-Binomial update policy. Independent of the taxonomy schema version and taxonomy content fingerprint.

profile_id.description: Stable, immutable identifier of this profile.

learner_id.description: Learner identifier within the application. Do not put a name or email address here.

language.description: ISO 639-1 code of the target language. This schema covers Italian grammar.

created_at.description: Profile creation date and time in RFC 3339 format, including a time zone.

updated_at.description: Date and time of the latest profile update in RFC 3339 format, including a time zone.

competencies.description: One record for every variant in the referenced taxonomy. An unpracticed variant starts at alpha=1, beta=1, mastery=0.5, confidence=0, with zero exposure and performance counts. Each taxonomy_node_id must be unique and valid. The application must compare ID sets with the external taxonomy.

bayesian_model.description: Update policy shared by all competencies. On a correct assessable answer add diagnostic weight w to alpha; on an incorrect assessable answer add w to beta; on not_assessable make no Bayesian update. Use w=1 for direct unambiguous evidence, 0.5 for reliable indirect evidence, and 0 when the answer cannot assess the variant. Diagnostic weight is independent of CEFR. After an update set mastery=alpha/(alpha+beta), n=alpha+beta-prior_alpha-prior_beta, and confidence=n/(n+confidence_scale). Recompute derived values rather than editing them independently.

prior_alpha.description: Initial alpha for every taxonomy variant before assessable answers.

prior_beta.description: Initial beta for every taxonomy variant before assessable answers.

confidence_scale.description: Positive constant k in confidence=n/(n+k), where n is the accumulated diagnostic weight above the prior.

diagnostic_weights.description: Allowed diagnostic weights. Classify an observation before updating: direct=1, indirect=0.5, not_assessable=0. Do not infer weight from CEFR difficulty.

direct.description: Weight for a task that directly and unambiguously assesses this competency.

indirect.description: Weight for reliable but indirect evidence about this competency.

not_assessable.description: Weight when the answer provides no valid evidence; alpha, beta, mastery, confidence, and trend remain unchanged.

trend_ema_factor.description: EMA factor lambda for smoothed_delta_new=lambda*(mastery_new-previous_mastery)+(1-lambda)*smoothed_delta_old after an assessable update.

trend_threshold.description: Classify the smoothed mastery change as improving above this threshold, declining below its negative, otherwise stable.

trend_min_effective_n.description: Keep trend as insufficient_data until accumulated diagnostic weight n reaches this value. This gate does not affect mastery or confidence.

estimated_user_level.description: One approximate CEFR level of the learner, used to choose the general complexity of sentences in cloze exercises. It is an estimate, not a certification. Do not lower it merely because the exercise practices basic words, and do not use it as a hard cap on the target grammar variant. Individual vocabulary knowledge must be handled separately by the exercise generator.

cefr_level.description: Single estimated learner level on the CEFR scale. null means that the available evidence does not support an estimate. This is the learner's level, not a CEFR label copied from a taxonomy variant.

confidence.description: Confidence in the estimated learner level from 0 to 1. Use 0 when cefr_level is null; limited or narrow evidence should lower the value.

level_assessment.description: Provenance of the current overall learner-level estimate.

assessed_at.description: Time this learner-level estimate was calculated or approved in RFC 3339 format; null when cefr_level is null.

source.description: Main source of the level estimate: diagnostic exercise, ongoing practice, import, or manual assessment. none means no estimate.

method.description: How the level was estimated: automatically, manually, or by combining both. none means no estimate.

evidence_count.description: Number of assessed exercise observations used for the current learner-level estimate; this is not the number of taxonomy variants.

algorithm_version.description: Version of the level-estimation algorithm, or null for a fully manual assessment or no estimate.

taxonomy.description: Unambiguous reference to the grammar taxonomy. The source taxonomy has a schema_version but no separate content release version, so sha256 pins its exact content. The taxonomy stores names, definitions, CEFR metadata, and relationships; this profile stores learner state.

id.description: Stable taxonomy identifier, for example italian-grammar.

schema_version.description: Value of schema_version in the referenced taxonomy file. This identifies the taxonomy file format, not its specific content revision.

sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the exact taxonomy JSON file. Use it to detect content changes and verify that competency IDs are interpreted against the intended revision.

uri.description: Location of the taxonomy document available to the exercise generator. A file URI is valid for a local application; another deployment must provide an accessible location. The JSON Schema validator does not fetch it.

competency.description: Learner state for one taxonomy variant. Exercises should target this variant or use its relationships and aspect descriptions in the taxonomy. Do not count CEFR aspects as independent competencies.

taxonomy_node_id.description: Stable variant ID from the taxonomy file pinned by taxonomy.sha256, for example CAT-01-CON-01-VAR-001. This is not a category, construction, or free-text name.

alpha.description: Positive Beta-distribution success parameter. Initialize at prior_alpha=1 and add diagnostic weight w after each correct assessable answer. It is cumulative state, not a raw count of correct tasks.

beta.description: Positive Beta-distribution failure parameter. Initialize at prior_beta=1 and add diagnostic weight w after each incorrect assessable answer. It is cumulative state, not a raw count of incorrect tasks.

mastery.description: Derived posterior mean alpha/(alpha+beta). A prior-only value of 0.5 is uncertainty, not demonstrated mastery. Use confidence and exposure when selecting exercises.

confidence.description: Derived evidence-volume score n/(n+10), where n=alpha+beta-2. Equals 0 for a prior-only variant. This is not a Bayesian credible-interval probability and does not account for evidence diversity or recency.

trend.description: Label derived from trend_state.smoothed_delta using bayesian_model.trend_threshold; use insufficient_data until effective n reaches trend_min_effective_n. Leave unchanged on not_assessable answers.

difficulties.description: Specific observed problems within this competency. An empty array means no identified difficulty, not that the learner lacks this competency.

trend_state.description: Minimal state needed to update a smoothed mastery trend without loading answer history. Before each assessable update, save the current mastery as previous_mastery; after updating alpha or beta, calculate the new EMA from the current smoothed_delta. On not_assessable answers, leave the entire state unchanged.

previous_mastery.description: Mastery immediately before the most recent assessable update; null if no assessable update has occurred.

smoothed_delta.description: Current exponentially smoothed change in mastery. Update with lambda*(new mastery-previous mastery)+(1-lambda)*old smoothed_delta, using bayesian_model.trend_ema_factor as lambda.

assessable_updates.description: Number of answer events with positive diagnostic weight applied to this competency. Unlike effective n, this is an unweighted count; it is not incremented for not_assessable events.

exposure.description: How many opportunities the learner had to practice this topic. Exposure alone does not establish mastery.

tasks_shown.description: Total number of tasks shown to the learner for this node, including tasks that may have been skipped.

tasks_attempted.description: Total number of tasks on which the learner attempted an answer. Must not exceed tasks_shown; the application checks this relationship.

last_shown_at.description: Time the most recent task was shown, in RFC 3339 format; null if there has been no exposure.

task_types_seen.description: Cloze format shown to the learner. Contains fill_blank after the first task is shown.

performance.description: Aggregated outcomes of first answers. Counts refer to tasks, not individual clicks or answer revisions.

first_attempts.description: Number of graded first answers across the full history; must not exceed exposure.tasks_attempted.

first_attempt_correct.description: Number of correct first answers across the full history; must not exceed first_attempts.

last_attempt_at.description: Time of the latest answer attempt in RFC 3339 format; null if there have been no attempts.

difficulty.description: One recurring or significant difficulty supported by observations, including the conditions in which it appears.

code.description: Stable error-type code within this competency, for example auxiliary-selection. Use it to group similar observations.

description.description: Short, AI-readable explanation of the error and the correct rule. Do not include the learner's personal information.

severity.description: How strongly this problem should affect exercise selection: low, medium, or high. This rates the difficulty, not the learner's overall level.

contexts.description: Contexts in which the difficulty was observed. The generator should practice these contexts and also test transfer to others.

evidence.description: Representative, traceable observations supporting this difficulty. The list may be limited to the newest or most informative examples.

context.description: Task conditions in which the error occurred. Describes the stimulus, not a trait of the learner.

task_type.description: The only supported exercise format: fill_blank.

grammar_context.description: Relevant grammatical condition, for example a motion verb in passato prossimo.

communication_context.description: Brief semantic or communicative setting of the task, for example recounting a trip.

evidence.description: A single error observation that can be linked to a task and reviewed. Keep answer text short and free of personal information.

activity_id.description: Identifier of the session or activity in which this observation was recorded.

item_id.description: Identifier of the specific task within that activity.

observed_at.description: Time the error was observed, in RFC 3339 format.

task_type.description: The only supported exercise format: fill_blank.

expected_answer.description: Expected correct answer or relevant excerpt; helps the AI understand the rule being tested.

learner_answer.description: Relevant excerpt of the learner's answer showing the error. Do not store unnecessary text or personal information.

assessment.description: Provenance of the current alpha, beta, and derived mastery, confidence, and trend values. Assessment metadata is not required to recompute the Bayesian posterior but supports auditing and debugging.

assessed_at.description: Time of the most recent assessable update or approval in RFC 3339 format; null when only the prior is present.

source.description: Main source of assessment data: diagnostic test, ongoing practice, import, or manual assessment. none means no assessment.

method.description: How the current estimate was determined: automatically, manually, or by combining both. none means no assessment.

evidence_count.description: Cumulative raw count of assessable answer observations applied to this competency. This is not effective n or the length of difficulties.evidence.

evidence_window_start.description: Time of the first assessable observation included in the cumulative posterior, or null before any assessable answer. This is not a sliding window.

evidence_window_end.description: Time of the latest assessable observation included in the cumulative posterior, or null before any assessable answer. This is not a sliding window.

algorithm_version.description: Version of the Beta-Binomial and trend update implementation. null when only the prior is present or for an entirely manual assessment.

task_type.description: Open cloze exercise completed by entering the missing text. This is the only supported exercise format.
